detailed_description: The JSON to Kotlin converter turns a pasted top-level JSON object into Kotlin class code in the browser. You can set the root class name, package name, choose no serializer or Moshi, Gson, or Kotlinx Serialization annotations, and toggle data class and nullable output options. The tool includes a Load Sample button, parses the JSON with JSON.parse, generates the code, shows errors for invalid input or non-object input, and lets you copy the output. It is intended for quick model scaffolding and does not analyze OpenAPI files, create sealed class hierarchies, infer domain-specific adapters, or download `.kt` files.
usage_steps: Paste a valid top-level JSON object into the input textarea or click Load Sample.
Set the class name and package name fields if needed.
Choose a serializer option and toggle data class or nullable output options.
Click Convert to generate Kotlin code and review the output or error message.
Copy the generated Kotlin code from the output textarea.
usage_examples: Generate a starter Kotlin data class from a small API response object.
Compare Moshi, Gson, and Kotlinx annotation output for the same JSON sample.
Create nullable Kotlin fields from a pasted JSON object while prototyping a model.
Load the sample JSON and adjust the root class or package name before copying the code.
